docs.title: Technical Writer | Software Documentation | Data Documentation
docs.text:
I turn complex technical concepts, software systems, and data workflows into clear, structured, and accessible documentation.

Welcome to my technical writing portfolio. This space showcases my approach to explaining software functionality, documenting technical processes, creating developer resources, and communicating data-related information.

My background in Computer Science and experience with software development inform the way I approach technical documentation: with accuracy, clarity, practical examples, and an understanding of the people who use technology.

docs.title: My Approach to Technical Writing
docs.text:
I believe good technical documentation should do more than describe how something works. It should help its intended audience understand, apply, and troubleshoot the information presented.

My approach prioritises:

  • Accuracy and technical clarity.
  • Logical information architecture.
  • Consistent terminology and formatting.
  • Practical examples and reproducible instructions.
  • Audience-focused communication.

docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
I'm Ibifuro Brown Sunday, a Computer Science graduate with an interest in technical writing, software documentation, and data communication.

My technical background gives me an appreciation of how software systems are designed, developed, and used. I enjoy breaking down complex technical information into structured explanations that are accessible to developers, end users, and other technical audiences.

docs.title: Technical Background
docs.text:
My experience and learning cover technologies including:

  • JavaScript and React.

  • Python.
  • REST APIs.
  • Git and GitHub.

docs.title: Documentation Philosophy
docs.text:
My approach to documentation is guided by three principles:

  1. Clarity: Information should be easy to understand.
  2. Accuracy: Technical explanations should reflect actual system behaviour.
  3. Usability: Documentation should help readers accomplish specific tasks.
